fact: The Findex-based study reports bank account ownership in Algeria at 35% in 2024, a decline.

La Voix de l'Algerie, citing The Global Findex Data 2025, reports financial inclusion in Algeria at 35 per cent of adults, against a world average of 79 per cent; the same report puts adults making or receiving digital payments at 13 per cent.
Maghreb Emergent, reporting a Global Findex presentation by Dr Mohamed Amine Kessouri, puts Algerian adult bank or mobile account ownership at 35.3% in 2024.
